data.title: Fix native Android Hero node taps

data.body: Android Chrome 113 on the S24-class emulator receives a real native W3C tap at the visible Co-Living node center (540,1574 native px), but the R3F useTapHandlers path does not navigate. Native drag works. Diagnose the real pointer-event path, fix without regressing pan-y scroll or desktop behavior, and validate through the Appium S24 suite.

Implementation complete in faa3ca5. Replaced eventPrefix=client with a default R3F manager whose compute samples the live canvas rect and normalizes client coordinates relative to rect.left/top; retained eventSource, OrbitControls, tap classifier, and pan-y behavior. Diagnostic evidence: installed R3F prefix math maps the observed Android point (206,493) against a top=80,height=568 canvas to NDC y=-0.736, while canvas-local mapping is y=-0.454. A temporary post-fix browser trace then recorded DOM pointerdown/up and R3F mesh pointerdown/up at client (195,550.7) with canvas rect top=80, proving the adjusted ray reaches the node; temporary logging was removed before commit. Validation: focused coordinate+scroll tests 14/14; simulator self-test passed; typecheck passed; unit suite 160/160; build passed; focused Hero Playwright 6 passed/1 intentional skip; trusted touch+mouse test passed 3/3 serialized; fast matrix 142 passed/34 intentional skips. The first native pre-fix trace attempt was interrupted before interaction by emulator-5554 crashing under memory pressure while the FRAC-19 tablet emulator was active. Root owns the final S24 Appium evidence run.

PASS — independent cold review of FRAC-20 commit faa3ca5 against the canonical plan and acceptance criteria. No substantive findings. The change replaces R3F client-prefix normalization with live canvas-rect-local NDC computation, preserves the existing eventSource, OrbitControls, pan-y touch-action, tap discriminator, pointerdown propagation, route model, and visual/design behavior, and adds deterministic coordinate coverage plus trusted touch/mouse navigation coverage. Diagnostic evidence records the observed mobile point mapping changing from incorrect prefix NDC y=-0.736 to canvas-local y=-0.454, with a temporary post-fix DOM/R3F trace proving mesh down/up reached navigation before logging was removed. Independent validation: focused coordinate/scroll Vitest 14/14, full unit suite 160/160, pnpm typecheck passed, pnpm build passed, and simulator self-test passed. The designated browser profile passed 6 tests with 1 intentional skip on final full-sequence rerun; the focused tap test also passed 3/3 repeats after one isolated initial miss, so the miss was not reproducible. Fresh retained native evidence at test-results/mobile-simulators/2026-07-23T20-00-52-264Z passed overall from auto-boots for both Android profiles. S24-class Android 14 / Chrome 113 recorded native-webgl-drag passed and native-node-tap passed exactly once for Co-Living from / to /co-living, valid native coordinate scaling, toolbar heights 762/818/762 with collapse and expansion observed, and portrait-to-landscape rotation without reload. Tablet toolbar and orientation checks also passed. Both manifests contain zero failed records, zero fatal browser-log records, and zero route-health failures; doctor ok=true with no required failures. Reviewed the retained whole-device portrait/landscape screenshots for both profiles; no visual regression observed. Acceptance criteria met; task is ready for done.
